In quiescent endothelium, Del-1-alphaVbeta5 engagement induced Hox D3 expression and subsequent alphaVbeta3 expression/function, and Hox D3 antisense blocked Del-1-induced angiogenesis in chick CAM. Hox D3 is a demonstrated terminal TF readout in this angiogenesis model, not a universal Del-1 endpoint.

candidate_observation_snippet: Antibody-activated laminin-1 supported attachment, spreading, and neurite outgrowth of late embryonic retinal neurons. Function-blocking anti-alpha3beta1 antibody substantially inhibited neurite outgrowth while sparing spreading, whereas broad beta1 blockade abolished attachment, spreading, and neurite outgrowth. Alpha3beta1 was detected in embryonic rat retinal ganglion-cell layers and optic nerve; alpha3-deficient mouse cultures showed compensatory alpha6beta1-dependent outgrowth.

This is functional receptor assignment, not a purified ligand-affinity measurement and not an intracellular kinase or TF endpoint.
